sloka: एतत् अस्य धनुः भग्नम् एतत् अस्य शरावरम् ।अयम् अस्य रणे राम भग्नः सांग्रामिको रथः ॥३-६७-१८॥
transliteration: etat asya dhanuḥ bhagnam etat asya śarāvaram ।ayam asya raṇe rāma bhagnaḥ sāṁgrāmiko rathaḥ ॥3-67-18॥

translations.english: O Rama this is his broken bow, this is his quiver and this is his warchariot all devastated by me.
